entry.title: MPC Sample Rack 1.0.0
entry.summary: The MPC Sample's plugin rack on its own screen: add, turn on or off and remove plugins on the input, outputs, submixes and tracks. **New since 0.2.0 (in 0.3.0):** ON/OFF on a plugin MPC is running acts at once, with no restart (its input passes straight through, with a short crossfade). It lasts until MPC restarts; APPLY writes it into the project. Works alongside mpc-addin-commander 1.2.0, whose rack panel gets the same live toggle (interface 2, `mpc_sample_rack_live`). ## Requirements - A Gen2

The installer refuses anything else. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device.
